verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Mangopay requires hosted KYC/KYB verification for all user types (mangopay-docs-34) but there is no documentation of tunable onboarding tiers, minimum-to-start-selling flows, or explicit 'requirements-due' states tied to payout thresholds. Missing for 10: evidence of progressive/tiered KYC, payout-threshold gating, and a documented requirements-due state model for sellers.
